metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: Mean pairwise cosine of sampled finite, nonzero nonpadding item embeddings, mapped to [0,1]. Near 0.5 indicates mean cosine near zero; larger values indicate directional alignment. This measures geometry, not recommendation diversity or user preferences. Null means fewer than two usable sampled items.
metric_definitions.embedding_support: Catalog, usable, excluded, and sampled item counts and unordered sampled-pair count supporting the embedding geometry measurement.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean positive-minus-sampled-negative logit on training positions with nonzero positive and negative IDs and finite scores. Scale-dependent; not validation HR. Null means no measured positions.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: Nearest-rank 10th percentile of measured training margins; scale-dependent. Null means no measured positions.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of measured training pairs with negative score strictly above positive score. Ties are excluded from this event. Measures sampled separation, not full-catalog ranking or validation HR. Null means no measured positions.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of measured training margins below the reported eps threshold. Depends on logit scale. Null means no measured positions.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Includes measurement support, excluded missing-negative and nonfinite counts, and counts of measured margins below eps and zero. Category metadata is unavailable: category lists are empty and annotated support is zero. Simulator diversity/conformity traits and review attributes are unobserved.
